summary: Iteration 3 (KDS, Shifts X/Z, Reservations, Print/Email Receipt) fully tested. Backend pytest 8/8 passed. Frontend Playwright covers all new data-testids: KDS bump removes ticket, station filter works, KPI cards render. Shift clock-in/out flow works, live KPIs (revenue/orders/covers/tips/avg) render, X-report opens popup, Z-report row + btn-z-<id> visible after clock-out. Floorplan → TableActionModal → ReservationModal saves a reservation, table shows guest name + countdown (in 29m) and cancel works. Register pay flow opens receipt-body with correct subtotal/service/total/payment info; receipt-print opens popup; receipt-email fires success toast (mocked). CRM member row shows crm-receipt-<id> which opens the same modal.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/shifts computes stats for every shift in the list — O(N * orders_query). Fine now (limit 50) but consider aggregation pipeline for scale.

Reservations POST allows overwriting reservation_id on a table already in 'reserved' status (previous reservation is orphaned as still 'pending'). Consider rejecting when status=='reserved' or auto-cancelling prior pending reservation.

KDS `kind` fallback uses `course == 'drink' -> drink else food` — will misclassify products where the seeded product's `kind` is missing and course is e.g. 'starter' but item is actually a drink. Seeded products have kind so no user-facing bug today.
Shift `_shift_stats` filters closed_at >= clock_in using string comparison on ISO timestamps — works because both use UTC ISO from same code path, but a mongo datetime type would be safer.
Receipt.jsx doEmail is entirely client-side mock — no backend hit; matches spec (MOCKED).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1/2/3 all green. Backend regression: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest -o addopts= backend/tests/test_iteration3.py`. Note the /orders/{oid}/fire endpoint only fires lines where held==true, so KDS tickets require an order created with held:True lines then /fire (see helper `_make_order_fired`).
